advanced-tools-route.adminOnlyBody: This area lets administrators wire up tools that aren't in the gallery. Ask an administrator if you need a new app connected, or head back to <1>your apps</1>.

tools-access.selectOrganization: Select an organization to open advanced setup.
tools-access.subtitle: For tools that aren't in the gallery. You'll need details from the tool's documentation. Most people never need this — if the app you want is in the gallery, <1>connect it there instead</1>.

profile-action-dialog.restoreBody: This profile will be active again and can be assigned to agents.
profile-action-dialog.deleteBlockedBody: This profile is the organization default. Reassign the organization default to another profile before deleting it.
profile-action-dialog.deleteBlockedHint: Choose another access profile and make it the organization default first.
profile-action-dialog.archiveBody_one: This profile stops applying to {{count}} agent. You can restore it later.
profile-action-dialog.archiveBody_other: This profile stops applying to {{count}} agents. You can restore it later.
profile-action-dialog.deleteBody_one: This permanently deletes the profile and removes {{count}} assignment.
profile-action-dialog.deleteBody_other: This permanently deletes the profile and removes {{count}} assignments.

audit-tab.reasonLifecycle: This connection change was recorded in the app's activity history.
audit-tab.reasonNotInstalled: Permitted connections were not installed, so their tools were not added to this run.
audit-tab.reasonRateLimited: Blocked because it ran too many times in a short window.
audit-tab.reasonSecret: Blocked to keep a sensitive value from leaving.
audit-tab.reasonAskedFirst: Held for someone to approve before it could run.
audit-tab.reasonWaiting: Waiting — the app it needs wasn't ready yet.
audit-tab.reasonFailed: The app was allowed to run it, but returned an error.
audit-tab.mcpDeliveryNotInstalled_one: <1>{{who}}</1>'s run received 0 MCP servers — <1>{{count}}</1> permitted connection not installed
audit-tab.mcpDeliveryNotInstalled_other: <1>{{who}}</1>'s run received 0 MCP servers — <1>{{count}}</1> permitted connections not installed
audit-tab.title: Activity
audit-tab.description: What your agents actually did with your apps, newest first. Each line is one decision — allowed, blocked, asked first, waiting, or failed.
audit-tab.noMatchHint: Try a wider time window or different filters.
audit-tab.emptyHint: As soon as your agents start using connected apps, what they do shows up here.

smoke-lab-tab.toastRunStartedBody: The browser runner records each step as it completes.
smoke-lab-tab.offBody: The Smoke Lab is an experimental developer surface for exercising the integration paths against deterministic local fixtures. Turn on <1>Smoke Lab</1> under Settings → Experimental to enable it.
smoke-lab-tab.intro: Exercise every integration path (P1–P7) end-to-end against deterministic local fixtures — a fake OAuth provider and loopback MCP servers. Nothing here touches a real vendor or a real credential. Start the services, install the fixture apps, then drive the governed lifecycle from a browser smoke run. New here? Follow the <1>hands-on tutorial</1>.
smoke-lab-tab.noServices: No services reported. Start the fixture services above.
smoke-lab-tab.demoCredsBody: Type these into the fake provider's real consent page during a P1 (OAuth) smoke. Fixed fixture values — safe to show.
smoke-lab-tab.noStepsSelected: No steps recorded for the selected run yet. Run a browser smoke to populate the matrix.
smoke-lab-tab.selectRun: Select a run to see its steps.
smoke-lab-tab.noStepsForRun: No steps recorded for this run.

profile-detail.toastDuplicatedBody: The copy is not assigned to anyone yet.

profile-detail.savedUnassigned: Assign it to agents before it changes their access.
profile-detail.archivedNotice: This profile is archived. It does not apply to agents until it is restored.
profile-detail.checkAccess: Check what an agent can actually do

profile-detail.bannerSummary_other: {{app}} added {{count}} new tools since your last review

profile-detail.reviewDescription: Allow the tools this profile should use. Keep the rest blocked.

profile-detail.notAssignedHint: Assign this profile before it changes access.
profile-detail.settingDenyBody: New tools do not become available automatically.
profile-detail.settingAllowBody: New tools from selected apps become available right away.
profile-detail.editDescription: Update the profile name and description.
profile-detail.nameTaken: Another profile already uses this name.

profile-detail.removeOrgDefaultBody: Removing the organization default changes access for every agent that relies on it.

profiles-tab.pickAgent: Pick an agent to see what it can use right now.
profiles-tab.noAppTools: This agent cannot use any app tools right now.
profiles-tab.noActiveProfile: No active profile applies to this agent.
profiles-tab.noToolsResolved: No tools resolved for this profile. Add an include selector or refresh the tool catalog.
profiles-tab.patternWarning: Tools marked <1>pattern</1> were pulled in by a wildcard, application, connection, or risk selector rather than named explicitly — review them when the catalog changes.
profiles-tab.headerDescription: Reusable bundles of allowed applications, connections, and tools, assignable to agents, projects, routines, or issues.
profiles-tab.emptyDescription: Create a profile to group tool selectors, then bind it to the organization or a specific agent.
